module: Module 3: Fractional Lot Rounding & Remainder Allocation
title: Deterministic Remainder Ordering During Equity Ties
precondition: Acc 1 and Acc 2 have exact same equity ($10,000.00) and priority.Remainder = 0.01 lot.
expected_result: System resolves tie deterministically via lower Account_ID or oldest account registration timestamp; zero random behavior.
actual_result: Equity tie deterministically resolved by account ID order: winner is mem_001.
